title: Watercolour washes
lede: Loose watercolour and ink washes: a red bloom, green and blue ink washes, blue flowers, a blue ring, a figure in red and in blue, red blooms, a green flower and a blue handprint. The paint is translucent, so each wash takes the colour of its ground. PNG only, long side up to 1000px.
use_for: A soft patch of colour behind a title, a quote or a portrait.
colour_rule: As painted, translucent: each wash takes the colour of its ground. Never retint them.
notes: On night the washes mostly disappear, so keep them to light grounds.
